notes: 2x2 design: water vs SAPYR photosensitizer, dark vs irradiated. Control = water, not irradiated. Irradiation alone -> other_physical; SAPYR in the dark -> other_chemical; SAPYR + light (aPDT) -> other_chemical;other_physical (oxidative stress is a result, not the stated treatment). Exposure acute (5 + 10 min). Stationary phase from the summary; overnight culture resuspended in TSB at OD 2.0. Strain ATCC 25922 (DSM 1103); text calls it only a reference strain, so strain_group left out. Shaking not described, culture_mode left out. WT re-read: ATCC 25922 unmodified -> wild_type.
